name: Twelve Data
description:
Twelve Data gives Claude instant access to global financial market data through a single, AI-powered interface. Describe what you need in plain English and the connector automatically selects the right endpoint, builds the parameters, and returns clean results.

What you can do:
- Get real-time and historical OHLCV prices for stocks, forex pairs, cryptocurrencies, ETFs, commodities, and bonds across 50+ global exchanges
- Calculate 100+ technical indicators: RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands, EMA, SMA, ATR, Stochastic, Ichimoku, SuperTrend, VWAP, and more
- Access company fundamentals: income statements, balance sheets, cash flow, earnings history, analyst ratings, insider transactions, and key executives
- Monitor earnings calendars, IPO calendars, dividends, splits, and market movers
- Search and filter instruments by exchange, type, or country

Getting started:
A free API key is available at twelvedata.com. Paid plans unlock higher rate limits, real-time data, and premium datasets including extended fundamentals and global exchange coverage.

Twelve Data is used by thousands of developers, quant researchers, and financial professionals worldwide.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Twelve Data to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Twelve Data to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.twelvedata.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Twelve Data MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Twelve Data lists 27 MCP tools, including auth_status, currency_conversion, get_analyst_data, get_api_usage, get_company_info, get_company_news, get_dividends, get_earliest_timestamp, get_earnings, get_etf_data, get_financials, and get_ipo_calendar.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Twelve Data?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Twelve Data in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does Twelve Data MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Twelve Data requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Twelve Data is developed by Twelve Data. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
